sv.title: Minnesord om Peter Ingwersen
sv.summary: Professor Peter Ingwersen, Malmö, har avlidit i en ålder av 79 år. Han sörjes närmast av hustrun Iren Wormell, och av oss, hans vänner i Malmö.

en.title: Obituary for Peter Ingwersen
en.summary: Professor Peter Ingwersen, Malmö, has died at the age of 79. He is survived by his wife Iren Wormell, and by us, his friends in Malmö.
